narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One count was three too high, so I take three off the mean.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the three was taken off only one tree, not all fifteen.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Twenty two point six times fifteen is three hundred and thirty nine, which loses far too much.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>The mean cannot drop by three.
